scope: Taiwan official connector retains sufficient history depth (default 40 trading days, >=30 bars for training evaluation) for union of active paper and configured history symbols (2330.TW, 2317.TW); includes www.twse.com.tw in egress allowlist; guarantees timezone-aware available_time on tw_price_daily rows
author: Antigravity
review_status: pending independent Claude review; no approval claimed

design_choices.choice: Derive bounded monthly fetch windows based on target trading-day depth
design_choices.why: Rather than hardcoding TW_OFFICIAL_HISTORY_MAX_MONTHS=2, derive_tw_history_max_months computes max(2, ceil(depth / 15) + 1) bounded up to 12 months. When history_trading_days is not passed, existing tests calling fetch_price_history_records default target_days to TW_OFFICIAL_MIN_CLOSES_PER_ACTIVE_SYMBOL (2), preserving existing 2-month behavior and backwards compatibility.

design_choices.choice: Priority symbols union active paper symbols and SOURCE_INGEST_TW_HISTORY_SYMBOLS
design_choices.why: In provider_adapters.py, priority_symbols unifies active_priority_symbols from SOURCE_INGEST_ACTIVE_PAPER_SYMBOLS, configured_history_symbols from request or SOURCE_INGEST_TW_HISTORY_SYMBOLS (defaulting to 2330.TW,2317.TW in docker-compose.yml), and requested priority_symbols. canonical_taiwan_equity_symbol maps .TW to .TWSE and .TWO to .TPEX.

design_choices.choice: Slice history to history_trading_days while retaining the >=2 distinct closes guard
design_choices.why: In _taiwan_official, selected_dates takes sorted(by_event_time)[-history_trading_days :], retaining up to 40 closes (or configured depth) instead of truncating to the last 2 closes, while still enforcing that at least TW_OFFICIAL_MIN_CLOSES_PER_ACTIVE_SYMBOL (2) distinct closes exist so single-close failure tests fail closed.

design_choices.choice: Allow www.twse.com.tw in connector_definitions.py for tw-twse-tpex-official-market
design_choices.why: STOCK_DAY monthly price history endpoint resides on www.twse.com.tw; including it in allowed_host_patterns alongside openapi.twse.com.tw and www.tpex.org.tw aligns connector definition egress rules with deployment network egress.

The downstream training-session materializer rejects bare dates (YYYY-MM-DD) with SourceDatasetAuthorityError. _tw_price_available_time ensures that any date without an ISO 8601 timezone offset receives the Taiwan market post-close publication timestamp suffix (+08:00), preventing bare date leakage into tw_price_daily metadata and normalized_row.

test_boundaries: Tests use recorded official payload fixtures only with zero live network calls
Preserved published normalized_row contract unchanged without fabricating rows
No modifications to non-Taiwan connectors or un-scoped services
hosted_acceptance: not run; unit and contract tests verified locally in task worktree
